h1: Legacy app upgrades to a current, faster stack
overview: Older apps often run on outdated frameworks that are hard to hire for and risky to leave. We review your app, pick the safest route forward and move it in steps, so it keeps working while it improves. That can mean upgrading the framework, moving the database or rebuilding one module at a time. We test against your real data and give you a rollback plan before anything goes live.

faq: We aim for as little as possible. Work happens on a copy, and the switch is planned for a quiet hour, with the old version kept ready to return to. Premium includes a rehearsal of the cut-over.
Can you work in very old languages?

Often yes, to read and move them. In the review we tell you which parts we can upgrade directly and which are better rebuilt. Very old systems may need a longer project than one order, and we scope that honestly.
What if the original developer is gone?
That is common. We read the code, run it, write down how it works and flag anything risky. You end up with documentation you did not have before.
Do I need to freeze changes during the work?
Ideally yes for the modules being moved. We agree which parts are off-limits for the week, and we merge any urgent fixes into both versions so nothing is lost.
